description: In the mural past the second archway, a classic three-circle Hidden Mickey is painted into a cloud. Clouds are an easy place to hide the shape, and this one blends in until you look for it.

whereToLook.scene: Mural past the second archway on the trail
whereToLook.exactSpot: In the clouds of the mural. One cloud is the classic shape.

bestTip: Look at the sky portion of the mural and compare the clouds with each other.
funFacts: The trail is said to hold more than ten Hidden Mickeys. The leaves inside the first arch and the cloud past the second arch are the two easiest to find.
